_meta.name: forward_selection
_meta.description: Forward stepwise selection: REG_OLS with selection=forward grows the predictor set greedily by starting empty and adding the AIC-optimal candidate each round, halting when no remaining predictor improves the criterion. Sibling shape to 11_stepwise.json (bidirectional) — the forward arm is the canonical "start small, add as needed" subset-selection strategy. Forces the buffered orchestrator path.
